The kit mixer

Choose a look for each piece and the phone updates as you go. A dot (●) marks pieces on the screen you're viewing. Hover over a row, or tap a piece on the phone, to find it. Add a note under any piece; notes go out with Copy picks. Picks and notes save on this device and in the link. A Vellum* option means the kit has no vellum version of that piece, so it shows the brass one. Everything here is mock data.
